docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that fail to apply collapse grouping in detailed view
(--det) — Cargo.lock should still appear indented under Cargo.toml with proper
tree branch connector, maintaining the hierarchical relationship in table format,
and any deviation from the exact golden structure (wrong indentation, missing tree
connectors, or incorrect collapse logic) fails the comparison.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to map .rs to rust icon, .sh to shell icon,
.txt to text icon, or fail to distinguish between different config formats like
.json, .yml, .toml — each should have the json/config icon, not generic file icon.

Golden files: icon_mapping.golden -- PLS_COLUMNS=80 ./executable --icon=true (in dir with .rs, .sh, .txt, etc.)

CATCHES: implementations that fail on complex regex patterns with character
classes, anchors, and quantifiers, or that match incorrectly (case-sensitive
when should be insensitive, or vice versa).

Golden files:
    complex_regex.golden -- pattern ^[a-z]+_[0-9]+\.md$ matches file_123.md

CATCHES: implementations that don't correctly reverse the canonical name sort order
when using cname_ (reverse sort), or that fail to maintain the case-insensitive grouping
even when reversing.

Golden files:
    cname_sort_reverse.golden -- ./executable --icon false --sort cname_ <dir>

CATCHES: implementations that crash when displaying symlink errors in detail
view, omit error message when --det fields are present, or format the error
incorrectly in table/columnar output where alignment matters.

The error message must appear after the symlink arrow (󰜺) even with all detail
fields enabled.
Test js function for JavaScript escaping.
Test template with range and conditionals.
Test math.Pow function.
Test math.IsNum with float.
Test coll.JSONPath - improve coverage.

CATCHES: implementations that always return 0 regardless of the executed
command's exit code, or that incorrectly map command exit code 1 to a different
value, breaking shell script error handling.
Test exec command with non-existent directory.

CATCHES: implementations that don't search ancestors in correct order (eachDir
lines 293-313), skip intermediate directories, or don't find closest .envrc when
multiple exist in hierarchy.

No input files - tests findUp ancestor search order

CATCHES: implementations that re-download on every fetch instead of using
cache, don't check CAS before fetching, or fail to reuse existing files.

CATCHES: tcsh export that doesn't escape special characters correctly -
tabs, newlines, control characters should be escaped, quotes need handling,
and various punctuation needs quoting.

CATCHES: Stylish formatter that doesn't group by file, omits position info,
fails to include rule URLs, or doesn't show summary statistics.
Test empty-block rule.

CATCHES: implementations that omit confidence scores or set them to
incorrect values for different rule types.
Test help output shows all documented flags.

CATCHES: implementations that only detect os.Exit but not other exit
functions like log.Fatal — log.Fatal, log.Fatalf, log.Fatalln, log.Panic,
log.Panicf, and log.Panicln all cause program termination and should be
flagged as redundant in TestMain functions.
Test tcc -ar without proper flags gives usage error.
Test that ignored options are silently accepted.
Test string instructions (MOVS, CMPS, SCAS, STOS, LODS).

CATCHES: Verifies that TinyCC correctly compiles and executes each test
from the tests2 suite, matching the expected output exactly. This ensures
correct implementation of language features including control flow, data
types, standard library calls, preprocessor directives, and more complex
features like inline functions, bounds checking, backtraces, constructors,
and thread safety based on the specific test fixture being run.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support .set directive for creating symbol
aliases or constants, fail to resolve aliased function calls, or generate wrong
code when calling functions through .set aliases — would either fail to compile,
link incorrectly, or return wrong values from aliased function calls.

Golden files: 
    test_set_directive.c - C main that calls aliased function
    test_set_directive.S - assembly with .set directives for aliases
    set_directive.golden - expected output showing alias resolution
Test markdown table format is correct.
Test module with Replace and Update shows replaced module's update.
Test invalid -style value defaults to default style.
Test Direct column shows false for indirect dependencies.

CATCHES: implementations that don't correctly detect updates when Update
field exists at top level (should show the module in -update filtered output).

expected_value_samples: b'opens the activity log in an editor'
docstring_samples:
CATCHES: implementations that leave file in bad state after cancel (corrupted
content, unclosed entries, orphaned data), preventing new activities from being
started correctly, or that don't properly remove all traces of the canceled activity.
Each subcommand should have its own help that differs from main help.
Test stop when no activity is running.

CATCHES: implementations that truncate long project names, have buffer
overflow issues, or reject input beyond certain length limits.
Current should show elapsed time for running activity.

CATCHES: implementations that ignore the -cbin parameter (angle bin width), fail to
adjust cos(theta) histogram resolution, produce identical angular distributions for
different -cbin values, or crash on very small/large angle bin widths.

Golden files:
    (none - checks sori.xvg data point count and bin spacing)

CATCHES: implementations that fail basic solvation with default SPC water
model - they would exit non-zero, fail to create the output structure file,
produce an empty or truncated structure file, or not add any solvent molecules
to a system with plenty of available space.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to apply PBC correctly in mindist calculations,
produce wrong minimum distances near box boundaries, or ignore -pbc/-nopbc flags.

Golden files: mindist_with_pbc.xvg.golden -- minimum distance with PBC

CATCHES: implementations that fail to handle different groups for fitting and
analysis, produce wrong covariance matrix dimensions when groups differ, or
fail to fit on one group while analyzing another. Tests separation of fit and
analysis selections.

CATCHES: implementations that don't accept or properly handle -b and -e
time range parameters, either rejecting valid ranges or misprocessing
the time window selection.

CATCHES: implementations that miscalculate column width for the number column
when row counts reach double digits — they might not allocate enough space, causing
misalignment, or fail to adjust the column width based on the maximum row number.

Golden files: number_many_rows.golden -- ./executable --number many_rows.csv
Test unlimited sniff (0 means no limit).
Test body center alignment.

CATCHES: implementations that don't properly handle ASCII2 style — this style
uses spaces around column separators and only has a header separator, no borders.

Golden files: ascii2_number_indent.golden -- ./executable --style ascii2 --number --indent 2 basic.csv

CATCHES: implementations that ignore body-align parameter for data rows, always
left-align body content, or fail to calculate correct padding for centering —
data row content must be centered in each cell with roughly equal padding left/right.
